question.text: The point of intersection <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math> of the plane <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and the line joining the points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mfenced><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> divides the line segment <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></math> internally in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi><mo>:</mo><mn>1</mn></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mo>|</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>|</mo><mo>,</mo><mo>|</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>|</mo><mo>,</mo><mo>|</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>|</mo></math> are coprime) are the direction ratios of the perpendicular from the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math> on the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mn>1</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="|" close="|"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to _____ .

solution.text:
Given,

Plane: 8x+y+2z=0

Now equation of line AB:x-25=y-410=z+3-4=λ

Any point on line AB is given by,

5λ+2,10λ+4,-4λ-3

Now using perpendicular condition to find the point of intersection of line and plane, 85λ+2+10λ+4-8λ-6=0

⇒λ=-13

So, point of intersection will be C13,23,-53

Now let L:x-1-1=y+42=z+23=μ

Now any point on the line L is given by,

-μ+1,2μ-4,3μ-2

Now direction ratio of CD→=-μ+23i^+2μ-143j^+3μ-13k^

Now again using the perpendicular condition we get,

-μ+23(-1)+2μ-1432+3μ-133=0

⇒μ=1114

Hence, CD→=-542,-13042,8542

Now on simplifying the Direction ratios we get, -542,-13042,8542≡-1,-26,17

Now on comparing with  a,b,c we get, a+b+c=10.
